name: fig18_absorption_cross_section
caption: Absorption cross-section of the Schwarzschild black hole for a massless scalar from the computed transmission probabilities. It tends to the horizon area as omega -> 0 (Das, Gibbons and Mathur 1997) and oscillates around the geometric-optics value (27/4) pi r_s^2 at high frequency (Sanchez 1978). Adding one further multipole changes sigma by at most 9.2e-11 (relative) over the range.
